name: Fusion20
description: Draft, for the author to rewrite before submission (FD22). Tracks fusion criticals for D&D 5e: when a Beyond20 attack rolls a natural critical, Fusion20 asks for a target, offers the allies who can reach and see it, and follows the chain while partners keep critting. Set each character's attack ranges in a fusion20_range attribute, such as melee=5,ranged=150. Allied non player characters are marked with the green status marker.
